The GovCloud front page (Statens It) says GovCloud is being phased out and replaced by SIT Cloud Kubernetes Services and takes no new customers, i.e. a state-run cloud platform currently exists and runs; the annual report confirms SIT Cloud is under development. A government cloud is thus in operation, though the source shows it is in transition rather than a stable platform.

All three quotes found. The GovCloud page says applications and data are at all times located in Statens It's data centres in Denmark, the 2025 annual report records work in progress on a new data centre (and expansion of current data centres), and Statens It describes itself as the state's IT operations provider. Together they support state-operated data centres in operation today.

The source presents the agency as the body responsible for the system; it does not say whether technical operation is outsourced.
